page.overview:
Who is Agilieth?

In 2021, the demon possessed Kevin, the boyfriend of an unnamed princess. They went to a church to get married, so Johanna Constantine (disguised as a priest), tricked him into reciting an exorcism spell, forcing the demon to reveal itself.

As the real priest escorted the princess out, Johanna proceeded with the exorcism, and when the demon refused to reveal his name, Dream appeared and exposed him as the demon Agilieth.

The demon also recognized him as the King of Dreams, and noticed that Morpheus was without his helm, claiming that he knew the name of the demon in possession of the object, which he was willing to give up in exchange for the princess.

However, before Dream could agree to the terms, Johanna exorcised Agilieth to Hell.
